message.content: Draft the day-one section for docs/onboarding.md: what a new hire does on their first day.

content.text:
Here's a draft:

## Day one

On your first day you will basically want to start by picking up your laptop from the front desk, and it is worth noting that the laptop comes pre-imaged, so in order to get started you just need to sign in. After that, you should join the #welcome channel, where your buddy will say hello. VPN access is granted automatically within 24 hours.

message.content: Good. Add a short paragraph on who to ask for access to the staging environment.

content.text:
## Staging access

For staging access, ask in #platform-help. The platform team approves requests the same day, and approval is basically always granted for engineers.
